instruction: Configure rsyslog to compress rotated logs
Set syslog-ng to log from specific facility only
output: echo 'filter f_authpriv { facility(authpriv); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/authpriv.conf && echo 'destination d_authpriv { file("/var/log/authpriv.log"); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/authpriv_dest.conf

instruction: Use rsyslog to log to a PostgreSQL database
output: echo 'module(load="ompgsql")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/pgsql.conf && echo 'action(type="ompgsql" server="localhost" db="syslog" uid="rsyslog" pwd="password")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/pgsql.conf

instruction: Create syslog-ng configuration with TLS mutual auth
output: echo 'source s_tls_mutual { tcp(ip("0.0.0.0") port(6514) tls(key_file("/etc/ssl/private/syslog.key") cert_file("/etc/ssl/certs/syslog.crt") peer_verify("required-untrusted") ca_dir("/etc/ssl/certs"))); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/tls_mutual.conf

Configure syslog-ng with logrotate integration
output: echo 'destination d_rotated { file("/var/log/messages" perm(0640) owner("root") group("adm")); };' >> /etc/syslog-ng/conf.d/logrotate.conf

output: echo 'global(workDirectory="/var/spool/rsyslog")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/performance.conf && echo 'action(type="omfwd" target="192.168.1.100" port="514" protocol="tcp" queue.type="linkedlist" queue.size="1000000" queue.dequeueBatchSize="1000")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/performance.conf
